conventions.worktree: one per task, from origin/main, via `git gtr new <branch> --from origin/main --yes` (verify with the guard in the working-in-worktrees skill)
conventions.review: adversarial review by a separate agent per REVIEW.md before the PR opens; fixes land; then PR
conventions.models: builders and reviewers: opus, effort high; mechanical-only slices may use sonnet
conventions.pr: branch named after the task slug; body `Closes DOR-<n>` only when the PR completes the ticket; label review:light|deep as fits; never arm auto-merge before the automated review has posted and its threads are resolved
